method.inclusion: Every 100-item confirmation case where at least one of none, lean, or candidate-02 was incorrect
method.coding: Fixed taxonomy, arm-masked responses, two independent coders, blind adjudication
method.raw_prompts_and_responses: Ignored local artifacts because source license metadata is unknown

conclusions: 56 of 62 coded error cases (90.3%) were attributed to task-label ambiguity or missing repository context, not skill instructions.
All seven candidate-specific harms were attributed to task-label ambiguity or missing repository context.
Candidate 02 looked strongest on three-gold-file tasks (+20pp) but lost on one- and two-gold-file tasks; the 28-item pilot overrepresented three-file tasks.

Only six cases were classified as skill-instruction-fixable. Correcting all six without regressions would move lean from 50% to 56% while no-skill remains 55%, a taxonomy-implied differential of only +1pp.
The static issue-only forced-treatment benchmark does not supply the observable repository evidence that the shipped scientific-method skill explicitly requires.

recommended_experiments.name: tool-enabled localization
recommended_experiments.change: Give both arms the same repository inventory and bounded read/grep budget; test whether the skill chooses more discriminating observations.

recommended_experiments.name: single-owner static benchmark
recommended_experiments.change: Use exactly one defensible implementation-owner gold file per task, or use set-valued scoring instead of forcing one path on multi-owner patches.
recommended_experiments.purpose: Remove the multi-file mixture that produced the pilot's winner's-curse signal.

recommended_experiments.name: module-role prior
recommended_experiments.change: On fresh tool-enabled tasks only, test an isolated instruction to prefer the module implementing the behavior over UI, route, or orchestration surfaces.
recommended_experiments.gate: No regression on explicit-clue and single-owner cases

recommended_experiments.name: clue-first fast path
recommended_experiments.change: On fresh explicit-symbol cases, preserve filename/function clues before generating alternatives.
recommended_experiments.gate: Must improve the explicit-clue slice without increasing total tokens
